title: Collatz map
summary: A piecewise integer map sending even n to n/2 and odd n to 3n+1.

context.note: Framework is named textually in this seed release; full recursive first-principles closure remains future work.

content.plain: Collatz dynamics repeatedly applies one of two arithmetic rules depending on parity.
content.exact: T(n)=n/2 if n is even, and T(n)=3n+1 if n is odd, for n∈N_{>0}. The orbit is n,T(n),T^2(n),....
content.caveat: The map is deterministic and discrete, but calling it chaotic requires a separate precise definition and proof.

relations.note: The conjecture concerns all positive integer orbits of this map.

verification.method: QEVA seed formulation checked editorially for mathematical coherence; no external formal proof artifact is claimed.
